research_rules.source_priority: Check the current exact-model manufacturer page first, then an attributable authorized seller if the manufacturer page lacks the selected-build field.
research_rules.weight_acceptance: Only record a complete-bike value when exact year/trim/build, size, and weighing basis are attributable. Keep manufacturer or retailer reference builds separate from an unidentified retained option; do not average, choose, or transfer between wheel builds.
research_rules.purchase_route_acceptance: Record only the exact mainland route and directly visible status. Do not infer selected SKU, stock, checkout, delivery, or payment from a generic product link.
research_rules.recording: If a current exact-source check resolves the retained field, add dated provenance and the supported fact. If not, keep the value unknown and record the concrete identity, option, or access blocker on the new field-specific attempt.
research_rules.stop_criteria: Process five targets sequentially. Stop each target at decisive exact evidence or one concrete access/identity/option limitation; do not repeat the earlier found attempt as a retry.
